name: Thai ghost story / folk horror
gm_moves: the spirit shows itself only to the one who broke the taboo
an elder warns them, then will say no more
an offering is gone, or left untouched
the village knows, and has kept quiet for years
a dream shows what happened, and who did it
fits: a curse from a broken vow
a krasue or a phi pop
checks: a ladder of 3+ steps that rise one after another
no empty story axis, and no seed fact contradicted
